method.boundary_exactness: reported descriptively; not a promotion gate because 5 req/s grid points can flip near 0.95

fallacy_scan.detail: Run stability is compared per allocation, workload, rate, seed, and threshold; no pooled direction is substituted.
The comparison unit is a seeded serving cell; requests remain constituents of a cell metric, not independent repeats.
All frozen cells are required and no cell is selected by outcome.
No post-treatment queue or latency variable is conditioned on in the stability comparison.
Both attempts retain all offered requests and count failures as SLO misses.
The rerun uses the same frozen seeds; it is run stability, not a new independent sample.
Any missing, failed, or incomplete cell blocks verification instead of being omitted.
The 10% cell-goodput tolerance and complete five-threshold family were frozen before inspecting r3.
The rerun command, matrix, tolerance, environment class, and timing-metric exclusion were frozen before completion.
Passing run stability supports measurement repeatability in this environment, not a universal mechanism claim.
Allocation is assigned before each cold-start serving session and cannot be selected by observed performance.

claim_boundary: Call this same-seed run stability, not an independent replication or additional n.
Do not pool original and rerun request denominators or seed counts.
Do not compare wall-clock duration as a deterministic reproducibility metric.
Restrict quantitative claims to this model, GPU, software revision, workload, and offered-load grid.
